stem: Why does the author use a metaphor in the quotation?
instruction:
Use “Why I Write Longhand” to answer the following question.

Read this quotation from paragraph 9 of the selection “Why I Write Longhand.”

Which is why, after years of making progressively heavier use of more apps and more devices to do things I used to do without any devices at all, I’ve thrown that train into reverse.

options.label: F
options.text: To show his fascination with technology

options.label: G
options.text: To highlight the difficulty in changing his habits

options.label: H
options.text: To explain his awareness that he is not alone in his use of technology

options.label: J
options.text: To express the sense of anticipation about his future

visual_elements: A boxed quotation: "Which is why, after years of making progressively heavier use of more apps and more devices to do things I used to do without any devices at all, I’ve thrown that train into reverse."
